resale_co.notes: Still not found in round 3. The Township website (berlintwp.com) has no construction, code enforcement or resale page and no resale certificate form. Round 3 searched the Township's WordPress media library and site search (resale, occupancy, smoke, certificate, inspection, rental, landlord) and read the text of about 200 posted minutes, agendas and ordinances (2020 to 2026): no resale CO or housing inspection ordinance was found. The only certificate of occupancy fee found ($100.00 for R-3 and R-5 in the 2023 construction fee ordinance, https://berlintwp.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/7-3-2023.pdf) is the Uniform Construction Code CO for permitted work, not a resale certificate. The Township has a Landlord Registration form (rentals only). Correction to round 2: the Planning and Zoning page lists Michael DePalma as Construction Official; Greg Fusco is listed as Engineer (round 2 had these swapped). Phone is the Township main line. The Township code (ecode360 BE0574) could not be opened.

requirements: District web page (2016) says the resale inspection checks smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms and a fire extinguisher; state law dropped the extinguisher in 2025, so confirm the current rule with the district

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the district's Application for Certification of Smoke Detector and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance and send it with a check to the Bureau of Fire Prevention, Berlin Township Fire District #1, 186 Haddon Avenue, West Berlin, NJ 08091 (fax 856-767-2248). The completed form and check must be received before an appointment is scheduled. Fees are non-refundable. The only form found is a 2017 version once posted on the Township website (Internet Archive copy); confirm the current form and fees with the district.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA Uniform Fire Code LEA Registry (July 2026) lists Berlin Township's local enforcing agency as a fire district (code D), and the DCA fire directory (survey 8/5/2026) lists Fire Official Joseph V Cornforth, 186 Haddon Ave, (856) 767-1839, firemarshal222@gmail.com (the same address is printed on the district's own form, so it is the office address, not a personal one). Fees come from the district's smoke/CO application once posted on berlintwp.com (file dated Dec 2017; Internet Archive copy of Sept 2019; the live file is gone). The amounts match the state default schedule, but they are quoted from the district's own form. www.westberlinfire.com now redirects to Facebook; its 2016 and 2019 archived pages describe the resale inspection but show no fees.
